description: The pie chart illustrates the Token Routing Distribution in FedHLM, representing the proportion of different categories. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, labeled "LOCAL" and colored green, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. The second slice, labeled "LLM" and colored red, accounts for around 3.9%. The smallest slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P" and colored blue, represents about 1.6%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices for "LLM" and "EDGE_P2P", while the proportion of "LOCAL" is inferred from the remaining percentage. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with "LOCAL" being the largest and "EDGE_P2P" being the smallest.
